actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological identity evidence: strong RNA pathway enrichment (30/50 Hallmark pathways, large effects) with a directionally coherent BAP1-up/PBRM1-low WXS trend, mirrored by C0002. Cross-modal diagnostics are estimable and directionally positive across all four modalities with no modality in active contradiction, and confounder testing shows no significant technical or site association. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though separation from C0002 is weak (near-zero silhouettes, high PAC), so uncertainty remains and this candidate is retained only for downstream validation.

C0002 has coherent biological identity evidence: strong RNA pathway enrichment (30/50 Hallmark pathways) that is the mirror image of C0001, with a directionally coherent PBRM1-high/BAP1-low WXS trend and WXS providing the strongest internal structural support. Cross-modal diagnostics are estimable and mostly positive (only a marginal negative CT silhouette), and confounder testing shows no significant technical or site association. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though separation from C0001 is weak, so uncertainty remains and this candidate is retained only for downstream validation.
